messages:
maya: FYI release is hitting a blocker: sampleapp CI failed after a regen. Looks like typegen changed a flag from optional boolean to a union, causing consumer break.

sam: link to diff?

maya: https://p.rw/diff4290  shows AuthRetryOptions: `retry?: boolean` -> `retry: boolean | 'legacy'`. No upstream API change.

lee: CI snippet:
> sample-app-tests
Error: Type 'boolean | "legacy"' is not assignable to type 'boolean'.

ci-bot: build #8471 failed  test suite: sample-app-auth

jordan: That was introduced by a stray spec commit that changed the vendor extension mapping. I picked it up when I rebased.

maya: We need a fast plan. Release is scheduled today.

sam: Short-term: pin the typegen tool in the release pipeline and revert generated types in sdk-js. Longer: add semver-guard that fails PRs when generated artifacts bump minor/major unexpectedly.

lee: Also stop auto-generating changelog entries for generated packages until we validate the mapping. It's polluting release notes.

jordan: I'll open two PRs: 1) hotfix revert in SDK, 2) spec cleanup to make x-auth-retry consistent. I'll add a pre-release hook to run `yarn typegen:diff` and fail on unexpected semver changes.

maya: Cool. Assign the hotfix to @jordan and the CI pin to @sam. I'll delay release if hotfix isn't in by 10:30 PT.

sam: Will add a proposal doc for semver-guard and a devex matrix test that runs sampleapp against a spec snapshot.

maya: Thanks team. Drop any other failing samples here. :thumbsup:
